description.short: Redlines buy-side M&A NDAs against the Unifi playbook.
description.full: Upload an NDA (.docx) in a chat with this bot. It reviews the agreement against the Unifi M&A (buy-side) NDA playbook and returns a Word redline with tracked changes and playbook comments, plus a summary and action items.
